name: NV Plugins
description: nv-plugins 4.44.0: the ACCURACY + DEAD-DOMAIN pass, fixing the user's round of reports on the Resident Evil (2026, tmdb 1423191) test title. (1) cinejoy 3.1.0: the site moved (cinejoy.to 301 -> cinejoy.pk, api.shegu.st dead 502) - native chain re-pointed to api.wing.st/cinejoy.pk (protocol unchanged, live-verified from the site's own network trace: /info + imdb.wing.st enrichment + /servers + binary /g -> HLS), and the device (no-timer) shared-subtitles pass no longer runs uncapped after rows exist - dead sub hosts can no longer ride a call past the app's 60s kill and zero extracted rows. (2) WRONG-CONTENT fixes per 'purstream, topcartoons, anikoto, Re:ANIME provides inaccurate stream links': purstream 3.0.0 verifies candidates through TMDB title + year +-1 AND the site's own sheet tmdbId cross-reference (no verified candidate -> zero rows, never the wrong movie - previously the 2021 Raccoon City film played for the 2026 release); topcartoons 2.6.0 verifies the WP-search article heading against the requested title (live repro: 'Resident Evil' served 'Ben 10 - Permanent Retirement'); anikototv 9.1.0 raises the title-match gate 0.25 -> 0.6; reanime 1.3.0 requires anilist-id or exact-slug equality instead of accepting any word-overlap candidate. (3) cineby 7.1.0: rows carried dead-domain cineby.at referers while the stream CDN is referer-allowlisted (vidking.net 200 vs everything else 403, live-verified on fresh tokens) - headers re-pointed to vidking.net; post-filter tail upgraded to the pack-standard FAIL-OPEN quality gate. (4) moviebox 7.1.0: isAdStream filter drops promo/ad/sponsor/teaser assets mixed into the bff stream list ('only ads' report). (5) Fold-in: vegamovies 1.5.0 + movieshunt 7.1.0 + torrents 2.1.0 carry the addon-side fixes (raw-source vcloud bridge, movieshunt.monster JSON lookup lane, torrents env-base overrides + per-request debrid config + 8s lane timeout) restoring pack<->addon byte-identity. The accuracy philosophy: a title absent from (or mismatched with) a site's catalog now yields ZERO rows - never inaccurate ones. Standing exclusions unchanged: kisskh/asianhub/pinoyhub/tagalogtorrents untouched; cinemacity stays Tagalog/Filipino; netmirror verbatim soryn paste untouched; asian-catalog needs no redeploy. 42 providers.
author: xrexzerox

Self-contained fail-soft: meetsQualityFilter >=720p, per-platform try/catch, module.exports = { getStreams }. Only addition vs the paste: guarded globalThis.atob fallback (device runtimes may lack global atob). No timers, no Alpha lane, no post-filter tail.

scrapers.name: Miruro
scrapers.description: Miruro v2.9.0 - DEVICE FIX: restores the device-proven v2.7.0 base (fail-open post-filter, CDN hint rotation, ani.zip mal+ani dual-route, pipe circuit breaker, deadline) and grafts the 2026-09 MegaPlay API fix: getSourcesNew AES "enc" decrypt + signed master.m3u8 token. Root cause of the device zero-rows: v2.8.0 took CryptoJS from the harness-only __nvRequire shim which does not exist in the real Nuvio runtime (require("crypto-js") is what the app provides) - so every decrypt failed silently on devices. Serves anikoto:* catalog ids as before.

scrapers.name: Pencuri
scrapers.description: Malaysian/Indonesian/Japanese/Thai movies & series from pencurimovie.baby (paired with the asian-catalog addon's 9 Pencuri sections: Movies, Series, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand, Most Viewed, Most Rating, Top IMDb). Plays catalog rows DIRECTLY by navigating the site's real page or episode page (asian:pen-<slug> rows, zero title searching) and resolves TMDB ids by site search for everything else. v1.4.0 ENGLISH SUBTITLES on every row (opensubtitles-v3, parallel fail-soft lanes). v1.3.0 MULTI-SERVER FIX (user report: only 1 stream and its not playing - have 8 server): Streamtape /e/ pages carry TWO get_video links and the #robotlink DIV token (v1.2.0's pick) is a DECOY answering 403/500; the provider now evaluates the innerHTML expression (eval-free: string literals + chained .substring with JS semantics) to get the REAL token, which 302s to tapecontent.net (verified 720p + 1080p) and re-signs per request at play time; quality labels come from the embed page's own filename with zero extra requests. NEW StreamHG lane for hgcloud.to/hglink.to (2 of 8 servers, was an unparseable stub): loader rotates to audinifer.com whose radix-36 packed script unpacks to a signed master.m3u8 (206 verified); quality from the playlist RESOLUTION line. unpackPackedScript is now radix-aware (10..62). Dead-filler voe embeds (Big Buck Bunny placeholder, verified on the sample) are rejected via a placeholder guard. dedupeRows keys the FULL url (Streamtape file ids live in the query - the old query-strip collapsed both embeds into one row). Dood (playmogo/dsvplay) stays turnstile-aware: the gate is unconditional (verified desktop UA / mobile UA / cookie attempts), so gated pages skip in milliseconds. Lanes: MixDrop packed unpack to mxcontent.net mp4, Streamtape expression-token get_video, StreamHG signed m3u8, Dood pass_md5, Voe JS-redirect follow, inline probe for unknown hosts - all parallel, all fail-soft, all hasTimers()-guarded. Hermes-safe: no unescape/escape/btoa/atob.
scrapers.author: xrexzerox

scrapers.name: Purstream
scrapers.description: Purstream v3.0.0 WRONG-CONTENT FIX ('provides inaccurate stream links'): the picker took the FIRST type-matching search hit - for Resident Evil (2026, tmdb 1423191) the site's first movie hit is 'Bienvenue a Raccoon City' (2021), so the 2021 film played for the 2026 release. Now three-layer verification honoring the 'add condition using imdb/tmdb search' directive: L1 candidate title must match the TMDB title (normalized, either-direction containment), L2 release year within +-1 of TMDB when exposed, L3 DETERMINISTIC - the media sheet's own tmdbId cross-reference must equal the requested tmdbId or the candidate is rejected (next candidate tried; none verifies -> ZERO rows instead of wrong ones). All fetches capped (guarded race on timers-runtimes; app-budget bounded on device).
